description: This Java class 'LwM2mTransportServerHelper' provides utility methods for handling LwM2M transport operations in Thingsboard, including sending attributes and telemetry, parsing XML to object models, and converting resource data for telemetry and attributes.

classes.name: LwM2mTransportServerHelper
classes.description: Utility class for handling LwM2M transport operations, including sending data, parsing XML, and converting resource data.

methods.name: sendParametersOnThingsboardTelemetry
methods.description: Sends telemetry parameters to Thingsboard, with overload for optional timestamp.

methods.name: toTsKvList
methods.description: Converts a list of key-value pairs into a timestamped list for telemetry.

methods.name: getTs
methods.description: Retrieves timestamp, either current or based on latest key timestamps.

methods.name: getTsByKey
methods.description: Gets or initializes timestamp for a specific key.

methods.name: compareAndSwapOrIncrementTsAtomically
methods.description: Atomically updates timestamp, sensitive to clock shifts.

methods.name: getCurrentTimeMillis
methods.description: Returns current system time in milliseconds.

methods.name: getValidateSessionInfo
methods.description: Builds session info from device credentials response.

methods.name: parseFromXmlToObjectModel
methods.description: Parses XML byte array into ObjectModel, with error handling.

methods.name: getKvStringtoThingsboard
methods.description: Creates key-value proto list with string value for logs.

methods.name: getKvAttrTelemetryToThingsboard
methods.description: Converts resource data into key-value proto for attributes or telemetry.

methods.name: getResourceModelTypeEqualsKvProtoValueType
methods.description: Maps resource model type to proto value type.

methods.name: getValueFromKvProto
methods.description: Extracts Java object value from key-value proto.
